caption: The drawing consists of a single thick, black line forming abstract geometric shapes on a white background. In the center, a diagonal line runs from the lower left to the upper right, terminating in an arrowhead at the lower left end and a forked or Y-shaped end at the upper right. Near the middle of this diagonal line, there is an intersecting curved line forming a semicircular shape, resembling an incomplete oval or sideways letter "D," which crosses over the main diagonal. The lines are solid and consistently thick throughout, and there are no other colors or objects present in the composition. The overall arrangement is minimalistic, with the black shapes standing out against the plain white backdrop.
title: Cattle Brand
